---
title: "IPUMS County Data Preparation"
output: html_document
---

## 1. Setup

This notebook prepares county-level socioeconomic
variables from IPUMS USA microdata for use in
roadway lane-mile statistical estimation.

Source: IPUMS USA

```{r setup}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(dplyr)
library(ipumsr)

# Load project configuration
source(here::here("R", "load_config.R"))
cfg <- load_config()

# Define IPUMS input file
ipums_file <- file.path(
  cfg$paths$input_dir,
  cfg$ipums$ddi_file
)

stopifnot(file.exists(ipums_file))
```

## 2. Load IPUMS Metadata

The DDI XML file describes the variables,
labels, and structure of the IPUMS extract.

```{r load-metadata}
ddi <- read_ipums_ddi(ipums_file)

print(ddi)
```

## 3. Load and Inspect IPUMS Microdata

This section loads the IPUMS person-level microdata
and checks that the variables needed for county-level
aggregation are available.

```{r load-microdata}
# Read the microdata associated with the DDI file
ipums_data <- read_ipums_micro(ddi)

# Check dataset dimensions
cat("Rows:", nrow(ipums_data), "\n")
cat("Columns:", ncol(ipums_data), "\n")

# Inspect available variables
names(ipums_data)

# Check variables required by the original workflow
required_vars <- c(
  "YEAR", "STATEFIP", "COUNTYFIP",
  "IND", "EMPSTAT", "EDUCD",
  "AUTOS", "VEHICLES", "POVERTY",
  "HHINCOME", "HHWT", "PERWT"
)

missing_vars <- setdiff(
  required_vars,
  names(ipums_data)
)

if (length(missing_vars) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Missing IPUMS variables: ",
    paste(missing_vars, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

cat("All required variables are present.\n")
```

```{r inspect-coverage}
# Check available years
sort(unique(ipums_data$YEAR))

# Check available states
sort(unique(ipums_data$STATEFIP))

# Count records by year and state
ipums_data %>%
  count(YEAR, STATEFIP) %>%
  arrange(YEAR, STATEFIP) %>%
  print(n = Inf)
```

## 4. Filter States and Create Variables

The original analysis includes eight western states:
CA, OR, WA, AZ, UT, NV, ID, and NM.

```{r prepare-variables}
# State FIPS codes
selected_states <- c(6, 41, 53, 4, 49, 32, 16, 35)

st_ipums <- ipums_data %>%
  filter(STATEFIP %in% selected_states) %>%
  mutate(
    # Construct county FIPS identifier
    FIPS = STATEFIP * 1000 + COUNTYFIP,

    # Identify manufacturing industry employment
    manuf = case_when(
      YEAR %in% c(1980, 1990, 2000) &
        IND >= 100 & IND <= 392 ~ 1,

      YEAR >= 2000 &
        IND >= 2000 & IND <= 3990 ~ 1,

      TRUE ~ 0
    )
  )

cat("Filtered observations:", nrow(st_ipums), "\n")
cat("Unique county/year combinations:",
    nrow(distinct(st_ipums, FIPS, YEAR)), "\n")
```

## 5. Validate Geographic Coverage

```{r validate-geography}
# Records by state and year
st_ipums %>%
  count(STATEFIP, YEAR) %>%
  arrange(STATEFIP, YEAR) %>%
  print(n = Inf)

# Check county identifiers
st_ipums %>%
  summarise(
    missing_county = sum(is.na(COUNTYFIP)),
    unidentified_county = sum(
      COUNTYFIP == 0, na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    manufacturing_records = sum(manuf, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

## 6. Create Socioeconomic Indicators

Create indicators for employment, education, vehicle
ownership, and poverty using the original methodology.

```{r socioeconomic-indicators}
st_ipums <- st_ipums %>%
  mutate(
    # Employment indicator
    emp = ifelse(EMPSTAT == 1, 1, 0),

    # Education indicator
    educ = ifelse(as.numeric(EDUCD) >= 70, 1, 0),

    # Vehicle ownership
    auto = ifelse(YEAR == 1980, AUTOS, VEHICLES),

    # Poverty indicator
    poverty_d = ifelse(
      POVERTY > 0 & POVERTY < 100, 1, 0
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(FIPS, YEAR) %>%
  mutate(
    poverty_s = sum(poverty_d) / n()
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```

## 7. Validate Socioeconomic Indicators

```{r validate-indicators}
st_ipums %>%
  summarise(
    total_records = n(),
    employed = sum(emp == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    educated = sum(educ == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    poverty_records = sum(poverty_d == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    missing_poverty = sum(is.na(poverty_d)),
    missing_poverty_share = sum(is.na(poverty_s)),
    missing_auto = sum(is.na(auto))
  )

# Examine a few records
st_ipums %>%
  select(
    FIPS, YEAR, emp, educ,
    auto, poverty_d, poverty_s
  ) %>%
  head(10)
```

## 8. Aggregate to County-Year Level

Aggregate individual IPUMS observations to county-year
records using the weights and definitions from the
original LaneMiles_Workbook.Rmd.

```{r aggregate-county}
st_ipums_ct <- st_ipums %>%
  group_by(FIPS, YEAR) %>%
  filter(
    HHINCOME < 999999,
    !is.na(HHINCOME)
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_hh_income = weighted.mean(HHINCOME, HHWT),
    s_emp = weighted.mean(emp, PERWT),
    s_poverty = weighted.mean(poverty_s, PERWT),
    d_poverty = weighted.mean(poverty_d, PERWT),
    educ = weighted.mean(educ, PERWT),
    auto = weighted.mean(auto, HHWT),
    auto_n = sum(auto * HHWT),
    s_manuf = weighted.mean(manuf, PERWT),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cat("County-year records:", nrow(st_ipums_ct), "\n")

head(st_ipums_ct, 10)
```

## 9. Validate County-Level Output

```{r validate-county}
# 1. Check record count
cat("Total records:", nrow(st_ipums_ct), "\n")

# 2. Check unique county-year combinations
duplicates <- st_ipums_ct %>%
  count(FIPS, YEAR) %>%
  filter(n > 1)

cat("Duplicate county-years:", nrow(duplicates), "\n")

# 3. Check missing values
missing_summary <- st_ipums_ct %>%
  summarise(
    across(
      everything(),
      ~ sum(is.na(.x))
    )
  )

print(missing_summary, width = Inf)

# 4. Check unidentified counties
unidentified <- st_ipums_ct %>%
  filter(is.na(FIPS) | FIPS %% 1000 == 0)

cat("Unidentified county-year records:",
    nrow(unidentified), "\n")

# 5. Check year coverage
st_ipums_ct %>%
  count(YEAR) %>%
  print(n = Inf)

# 6. Inspect variable distributions
summary(st_ipums_ct)
```

## 10. Export County-Level IPUMS Dataset

Save the processed dataset to the configured output
directory and verify the exported file.

```{r export-ipums}
# Create output directory if it does not exist
dir.create(
  cfg$paths$output_dir,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

# Construct output file path
output_file <- file.path(
  cfg$paths$output_dir,
  cfg$ipums$output_file
)

# Write CSV
write.csv(
  st_ipums_ct,
  output_file,
  row.names = FALSE
)

cat("Dataset saved to:", output_file, "\n")

# Read the CSV back for verification
exported_data <- read.csv(output_file)

# Verify dimensions and column names
stopifnot(
  nrow(exported_data) == nrow(st_ipums_ct),
  identical(names(exported_data), names(st_ipums_ct))
)

cat("Export verification passed.\n")
cat("Rows:", nrow(exported_data), "\n")
cat("Columns:", ncol(exported_data), "\n")
```
